answer.held_back_by: Mostly the late start in politics and the lack of a scholarship, plus the ceiling not rising until I asked for the hard ministry. I never self-advocated, so I probably got what the system assumed I wanted.
answer.ending_fair_why: Retiring as DPM with a clean file and people quoting me felt right for how I played. The ceiling reveal that the hard ministry ask raised it to PM was a nice sting. I am a bit sore that the unknown Minister never paid off.
answer.chase_next: Take the scholarship-track route and self-advocate more, to see whether the ceiling rises sooner and what it costs in integrity and in people's goodwill.
answer.play_again_why: It was a good run and the callbacks landed, but 49 years is long on an MRT commute. I would come back another week to try the scholar route.
